params.body:
The first `portal.share` from the workbench was judged and allowed, and the adapter found no document: `cmd/gateway` binds submitted files to the judged parameters only for `branch.push`, `review.publish` and `portal.expense`. A share always carries its document, so it joins that list: refused before any judgement when the file is missing or does not match `params.files_sha256`, handed to the adapter when it does.

Test: `TestAShareBindsItsDocumentBeforeTheJudgement` in `cmd/gateway`, with a fake Portal share door. Suite clean.

This needs a release (v0.39.0) and a pin, like #118.

params.title: Bind a share's document in the handler, the way a push binds its files
